snippet.title: Truck City - Announcement trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam! store.steampowered.com/app/3812200/Truck_City/

Truck City is a resource management city builder.

Grow your truck fleet, build your city and design a supply chain to extract, refine and process natural resources into complex items. Manage your factories and optimize delivery logistics to prevent traffic jams. Unlock new research and turn your small mining town into an efficient industrial city.
